before: Butter decremented alone and returned before ice/chill clocks; ice returned even when its counter became zero.
implemented: For represented living zombies past blown-away/kelp early branches, ice, chill and butter counters decrement independently in source order.
The immobilization gate reads remaining ice/butter after decrement. Final tick can resume actions and pogo falling.
No new saved fields, random calls, prices, health, images, display objects or tickers.

tests.fixtureCorrection: Initial motion assertions assumed fixed .2 walk speed, but actual normal-zombie walking is animation dependent. They now assert stopped vs resumed movement, the relevant native action-gate contract; corrected tests were rerun against the previous clock block and fail in both relevant cases.
tests.existingUnitCorrection: Pogo fall test now checks nine frozen steps retain height58, then the tenth step reaches counter0 and height57, following UpdatePlaying before UpdateActions. Two other old tests (native-pogo and scenes-save) likewise now assert no motion through counter1, then resumed action at counter0; pause and shield-damage controls are retained.

remaining: Native thaw particle event, frozen-body reanimation update order, sound restart and unrepresented state phases remain incomplete.
Custom boss cold clocks and early blown-away/kelp branches are outside this port.
Model contracts do not prove physical-phone CPU/RAM or complete visual/native parity.
